scope: Diagnostic shifts the objectBoundingBox radial width-mask gradient center from (0.5,0.5) to (0.3,0.3) before SVG-to-PDF export. Compares 84 captured records in a 192x192 target at baseline, translated 6 px with countershifted grain, and scale 2; native host-Mesa alpha uses corresponding pinned crops.
interpretation: A fixed normalized center shift improves the baseline and translation controls in both readers and scale2 in PDFium, but worsens scale2 in MuPDF. This changes the SVG paint and is not a portable vector correction.
limitations: Synthetic host replay of captured records, not full Drawing, device, saved-note or production parity.
No arbitrary transforms, other readers, or RGB evidence. Inputs and dependencies follow pencil2-v14-svg-pdf-control.json.
